# Idealista.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/idealista-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/idealista-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects property listing data from idealista.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Idealista.com in Python - Real Estate Property Data](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-idealista)
- **Code:** [`idealista.py`](idealista.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Property pages](results/properties.json) · [Search pages](results/search_data.json) · [Provinces pages](results/search_URLs.json) · [Crawl](results/crawl.json)

## What it scrapes

- Idealista property search for finding property listings
- Idealista property pages for property listing data
- Idealista province pages for property URLs

## Functions

- `scrape_provinces(urls)` → `List[str]`: Scrape province pages like: https://www.idealista.com/en/venta-viviendas/balears-illes/con-chalets/municipios for search page urls like: https://www.idealista.com/en/venta-viviendas/marbella-malaga/con-chalets/
- `scrape_properties(urls)` → `List[PropertyResult]`: Scrape Idealista.com properties
- `scrape_search(url, max_scrape_pages=None)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape Idealista search results

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import idealista


async def main():
    provinces = await idealista.scrape_provinces(
        urls=[
            "https://www.idealista.com/venta-viviendas/almeria-provincia/municipios",
        ],
    )
    properties = await idealista.scrape_properties(
        urls=[
            "https://www.idealista.com/en/inmueble/109061254/",
            "https://www.idealista.com/en/inmueble/109300670/",
        ],
    )
    search = await idealista.scrape_search(
        url="https://www.idealista.com/en/venta-viviendas/marbella-malaga/con-chalets/",
        max_scrape_pages=3,
    )


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields:

- **`PropertyResult`**: `url`, `title`, `location`, `price`, `currency`, `description`, `updated`, `features`, `images`, `plans`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`idealista.py`](idealista.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: Scrapfly's [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker), its anti-bot bypass
- `country` = `"ES"`: country of the proxy

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/idealista-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_idealista_scraping`, `test_provinces_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
